messages:
lucy (Design): dropped a quick note + frame: https://figma.redwood.example/file/snapback-sampling

lucy (Design): problem: users snap zoom into spikes and then lose their wider context. proposal: add a subtle 'snapback' control in the details panel that returns the range to previous bounds. copy idea: 'Return to previous range' or 'Back to overview'.

max (Eng UI): good idea. implementationally we need to store the previous range in history stack. small UX Q: should snapback be a button or a breadcrumb-like link? button feels clearer.

rina (Product): product preference: label should be actionable and clear. "Back to previous range" is fine. Also add tiny undo icon to reinforce affordance.

tom (A11y-bot): accessibility: ensure the snapback control is exposed in keyboard order and has aria-label="Return to previous time range". Also announce via live region when range changes: "Viewing: 12:00
M 10:00 AM (restored)".

lucy (Design): thanks. second related thing: sampling indicator microcopy. when heatmap is sampled (e.g., 1%), show a small badge: "Sampling: 1% (may hide short spikes)". keep wording concise and honest.

max (Eng UI): note: badge space is tight on small screens. suggest tooltip with full sentence and short badge text "Sampled: 1%". tooltip: "Data is sampled. Short spikes may not appear."

rina (Product): prefer "Sampled: 1% (short spikes may be missing)" in tooltip. we should default to showing sampling badge when sampling < 5% to avoid noise.

tom (A11y-bot): for sampling badge provide text alternative and ensure tooltip is reachable via keyboard. tooltip content should be in DOM (not only CSS hover) so screen readers can read it.

lucy (Design): acceptance criteria I'll add: - snapback button in details panel with undo icon and aria-label - range history stored for at least last 3 changes - sampling badge short text + keyboard-accessible tooltip - legend note appears when sampling <5% and links to docs

max (Eng UI): implementation notes: range history is per-board state; persist only in session. tooltip will use an accessible popover component. will prototype next week behind feature flag.

rina (Product): let's A/B test snapback enabled vs not for 10% to measure usage and support tickets. also track clicks on sampling tooltip to docs
